quote: "I was in the smoking-room all evening," he said, short as a docket. "Mrs Harrow and I argued, certainly. We argued about money and the will. But I did not go near the library after nine."
"I went to her window," he said. "I couldn't stand her tallying me... I took the sheet out. I could not have it in her book. It would have ruined me."
"I went to her window," he said. "I couldn't stand her tallying me — the things she had written... I took the sheet out. I could not have it in her book. It would have ruined me."
He told them how he'd fixed the loop in the ivy, knotted the cord, made the opener a weight and a blade for the same motion, and how he'd pulled the sash neat again.
